title: Decision Desk: Who Texts First
old_caption:
The first date ended at 10. The decision desk tracked every draft and every deleted "had fun."
Results at the end. Are you the one who texts first?

title: Good Morning, Stars: First Date Tonight
old_caption:
A Virgo with a first date tonight and a list of fourteen topics. We have traffic, weather and a live follow-up at 10 p.m.
Nervous means it matters.

title: Year in Review: The Stars' Biggest Stories
old_caption:
Twelve signs, twelve small wins, one co-anchor who cried at every single one.
The top story will get you. What was your sign's biggest win this year?

title: The Handover
old_caption: Sag tossed over the keys. Capricorn changed the password, posted a calendar and tucked Sag into bed. Longest night of the year, earliest bedtime. Welcome to Cap season.

title: Cap Plans Date Two
old_caption: Capricorn planned date two to the minute: 6:04 compliment, 6:07 laugh. Then crossed it all out for one better line. What's your ideal second date?

title: Cap Doesn't Cry
old_caption: Capricorn does not cry at movies. Capricorn does, it turns out, shed one tear over a small handmade card. Allergies, obviously. Who's your secret softie?

title: The Seating Chart
old_caption: Capricorn brought a color-coded seating chart and a ruler. Then gave its own seat to the new grandma without a second thought. Tag the planner who always makes room.

title: Cap Wraps a Gift
old_caption: Capricorn: forty minutes, perfect corners, a level. Sagittarius: three seconds, one ball of tape. Only one of them hid a letter inside. Which wrapper are you?

title: Cap Says One Yes
old_caption: Four party invites. Capricorn picks one, shows up on time with a gift and actually listens. Are you a one-party or an every-party person?

title: Cap's Snow Day
old_caption: Capricorn's plans got snowed in, so it drew a blueprint for a snowman. The lumpy one still made the photo. Best day you never planned?
